title: runs/<run-id>/facts.yaml
description: The only home of system facts (INV-4, plan §7.2). Each fact is an object with set_by_task, the task that wrote it (framework tasks' writes_facts name these dotted paths). Facts accumulate during a run, so none is required here; FACTS-001 checks completeness after C-3.

nss.title: Whether the system is a national security system under 44 U.S.C. 3552(b)(6) (C-1, from P-16's determination); every rule that turns on NSS status reads this fact (NSS-001 holds the other records to it)

basis.title: Which statutory criterion applies (intelligence, cryptologic, command and control, weapons, or critical to military or intelligence missions), or why none does; using CNSSI 1253 does not by itself make a system an NSS

categorization.description: CNSSI 1253 categorization: one impact value per security objective, plus the applicable overlays. Set by C-2; approved by C-3.

c.title: System confidentiality impact level: one of the three levels of potential impact, low, moderate or high; the value of not applicable cannot be assigned to a security objective of an information system

i.title: System integrity impact level: one of the three levels of potential impact, low, moderate or high

a.title: System availability impact level: one of the three levels of potential impact, low, moderate or high

privacy_baseline.title: Whether the NSS privacy control baseline applies, and why: CNSSI 1253 makes it a default for every NSS, and a DoD system that is not an NSS may keep it because DoDI 8510.01 directs CNSSI 1253 selection, or leave it out with a basis (dry-run finding F-05-10). Absent, the resolver applies it.

space_segments.title: The segments of a space NSS the system is part of (Space Platform Overlay Figure 1); the overlay's scope is the space platform and the link segment interfacing with it

factors_reviewed.title: The factors the provisional impact levels were reviewed against: organization, environment, mission, use, data sharing and national interest, and any other factor weighed

adjustments.title: Each adjustment of a system impact level away from the high-water mark of the information types, with the factor and rationale

documented_in.title: The capability requirements document the categorization is documented in: the CDD or the equivalent requirements document P-15 read (ACQLC-005)

revisit.title: When the categorization is revisited: at significant change, situational change, and at least every three years

method.description: cnssi1253 normally; high-water-mark only under the degraded policy (plan §7.6).

date.title: Date of the review of the categorization by the authorizing official or designated representative

privacy.title: Approval by the SAOP or designee of the determination whether the system processes PII, of the Privacy Overlays selected, and for a system that processes PII of its security categorization

pii.title: The approved determination whether the system processes PII

designee_of.title: PER-PRIV when the approval is by the designee of the SAOP

overlays.title: The Privacy Overlays the SAOP or designee approved for the system

logs_pii.title: Whether any log of the system includes PII; false is the SAOP's or designee's confirmation that the logs need no Privacy Overlay

acquisition.description: Acquisition pathway and kind of product. AODM-007 reads them for a cATO.

pathways.title: Every acquisition pathway the program combines, with MDA or DA approval, in the order it takes them up and including the system's own pathway; protection.yaml program.transitions defines each transition point (ACQLC-001)

covered_dbs.title: Whether the program meets the definition of a covered defense business system, which uses the DBS pathway and may add the software pathway for custom software (ACQLC-001)

classification.title: Data classification level and handling markings of the system (C-1); SYSD-001 holds it against the Classified System Overlay

value.title: Highest classification level of the information the system stores, processes or transmits

compartments.title: Sensitive compartmented, special access program and Atomic Energy Act markings

handling_markings.title: Dissemination controls and other handling markings, such as CUI or NOFORN; empty when none apply

system_type.title: Information technology type of the system and why (C-1); SYSD-001 reads it

value.title: IT type: enclave, major application, platform IT system or general support system
value.description: pit, it-service and it-product are below the system level: they take no ATO and complete the Assess Only process (DoDI 8500.01 Figure 2, DoDI 8510.01 p. 13)

connectivity.title: Whether the system is stand-alone or networked

dodin_connection.title: Whether the system connects to the DODIN directly, indirectly or not at all

designated_by.title: Who designated the PIT system as such: the responsible OSD or DoD Component head, or a delegate

registered_in.title: The DoD Component register that holds the PIT system

pit_ao_appointed.title: Whether the AO was specifically appointed to authorize PIT systems

hosts.title: Information systems the enclave hosts, with their categorization

owning_organization.title: Parent or governing department, agency or organization that manages, owns or controls the system (C-1)

system_version.title: Version or release number of the system and its release date (C-1)

value.title: Production, test, research and development, tactical, deployed or other

current.title: Where the system runs today, when it differs from the environment being authorized (value), for example a pre-production account before release (dry-run finding F-04-11)

lifecycle_phase.title: Acquisition life-cycle phase of the system: 1 MSA, 2 TMRR, 3 EMD, 4 P&D, 5 O&S (C-1)

pathway_phase.title: The pathway's own phase when it has its own, such as the software acquisition pathway's planning or execution phase, which value maps to the MCA spine (dry-run findings F-00-4, F-04-11)

missions.title: The missions, business functions and mission/business processes the system is intended to support, identified by the mission or business owner (P-8)

identified_by.title: The mission or business owner who identified them

essential.title: A mission essential function, whose supporting assets and data are captured (cATO IC01)

supported_by.title: The components of boundary.yaml that support it

data.title: The information types of infotypes.yaml that support it
